summary: Complaints centre on factory pollution and the Sahibabad drain, broken and waterlogged roads, and garbage fires; the only appreciation found is the Namo Bharat station (2023) and the Vasundhara flyover (2019), and no 2024-2026 delivered project was found.

positives.english: Namo Bharat train from Sahibabad station has made travel to Delhi and Meerut easier
positives.hindi: नमो भारत चलने से साहिबाबाद से दिल्ली और मेरठ जाना आसान हुआ
positives.basis: Wikipedia: Sahibabad RRTS station was commissioned on 20 October 2023 and opened to the public on 21 October 2023; run by NCRTC on solar power (1,100 roof panels). District-level; AC membership of the station not confirmed.

positives.english: Vasundhara flyover lets Mohan Nagar traffic reach UP Gate without stopping
positives.hindi: वसुंधरा फ्लाईओवर से मोहन नगर से यूपी गेट बिना रुके पहुंच जाते हैं
positives.basis: ETV Bharat (7 June 2019): Rs 49 crore Vasundhara flyover opened; it provides travel from the Mohan Nagar side to UP Gate without any stoppage. 2019 source, district-level; AC membership not confirmed.

positives.english: * Drain work in Rajendra Nagar will start so rainwater can drain away
positives.hindi: * राजेंद्र नगर में नाला बनने वाला है, बारिश का पानी निकलेगा
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (18 Aug 2026) says the tender for the RCC drain and road in Rajendra Nagar Sector-5 is complete and construction is to begin within 10 days. Not yet a delivered benefit; AC membership unconfirmed.

positives.english: * Easier to reach the industrial area from Indirapuram and Vasundhara
positives.hindi: * इंदिरापुरम और वसुंधरा से इंडस्ट्रियल एरिया जाना आसान होगा
positives.basis: Inference: ETV Bharat (7 June 2019) says the flyover will let Indirapuram and Vasundhara residents reach Industrial Area Site 4 without jams. This is the article's expectation, not a resident quote; 2019 source, AC membership unconfirmed.

positives.english: * Easy to get to Metro and Namo Bharat stations by auto from here
positives.hindi: * मेट्रो और नमो भारत पास होने से ऑटो से आना-जाना आसान है
positives.basis: Inference: no source found on auto access or station connectivity for this AC. The Wikipedia station page was removed as a source because it does not state this.

negatives.english: Waste from about 1700 factories reaches the Yamuna through the Sahibabad drain
negatives.hindi: 1700 फैक्ट्रियों का गंदा पानी साहिबाबाद के नाले से यमुना में जाता है
negatives.basis: ETV Bharat (28 July 2025): waste from about 1700 factories reaches the Yamuna through the Sahibabad drain, which flows through Sahibabad Industrial Area Site-4; BOD 220 mg/l, ideal 30 mg/l per the article. District-level; Site-4 AC membership not confirmed.

negatives.english: Rainwater collects in Rajendra Nagar Sector-5 and roads are damaged
negatives.hindi: बारिश में राजेंद्र नगर सेक्टर-5 में पानी भरता है, सड़कें टूटी हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (18 Aug 2026), dateline Sahibabad: water collects at several spots in Sector-5 during rain and waterlogging has damaged the roads; the article says about 30,000 people will directly benefit from the project. AC membership of Rajendra Nagar Sector-5 not confirmed.

negatives.english: Vehicles passing the broken road in Sahibabad industrial area kick up dust
negatives.hindi: टूटी सड़क से गाड़ियां गुजरती हैं तो धूल उड़ती है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala video report (30 Oct 2025): road broken near Indraprastha Dental College in Sahibabad industrial area; vehicles passing over it kick up dust. Short report, no resident quotes. District-level; AC membership not confirmed.

negatives.english: Garbage piles along roads in Site IV industrial area catch fire and send smoke
negatives.hindi: सड़क किनारे कूड़े के ढेर में आग लगती है और धुआं फैलता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala video report (12 Apr 2025): roadside garbage on fire in Sahibabad Site IV industrial area, smoke rising. Short report, no official or resident quotes. District-level; AC membership not confirmed.

negatives.english: 120 factories in the district did not install chimney filters and got a second notice
negatives.hindi: जिले की 120 फैक्ट्रियों ने चिमनी पर फिल्टर नहीं लगाए, दूसरा नोटिस
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (21 Aug 2026), dateline Sahibabad: UPPCB issued a second notice to 120 industrial units in Ghaziabad district to install chimney filters, deadline 30 September 2026. District-level, not AC-specific.

notes: AC identity confirmed from Wikipedia list (no. 55 Sahibabad, Ghaziabad, general seat). The Wikipedia Sahibabad AC page gives the extent as Ghaziabad M Corp wards 1, 8, 9, 13, 14, 16, 18, 19, 20, 25, 26, 30, 33, 38, 41, 50, 55 and 60, plus PC Arthala and Makanpur of Loni KC. It names no locality, so Site IV, Rajendra Nagar, Vasundhara, Indirapuram and Khoda are unconfirmed for AC 55 and all negatives are district-level; ac_specific_negatives is 0. Searches in Hindi and English for 2024-2026 completed local projects (roads, drains, flyovers, Sahibabad MLA inaugurations) and for news naming the Sahibabad vidhan sabha found nothing usable. The only 2026 local item is a tender for Rajendra Nagar Sector-5 that has not yet been delivered. Both positives with delivered benefits are old (2019 flyover, 2023 station). Field check recommended: ward membership for Site IV, Rajendra Nagar and Vasundhara, and the status of the Sahibabad drain works. P3 weak positive: tender only; drain work not started yet, so the statement is a forecast. P4 weak positive: the 2019 article's expectation, not a resident quote or a delivered benefit. P5 weak positive: no source found for auto access; kept only as a flagged inference.

round2.changes: Verified all 9 cited article sources by fetching them and the Wikipedia AC page (extent: Ghaziabad M Corp wards 1,8,9,13,14,16,18,19,20,25,26,30,33,38,41,50,55,60; PC Arthala and Makanpur of Loni KC; no Site IV, Rajendra Nagar, Vasundhara, Indirapuram or Khoda named). Removed the Wikipedia RRTS source from the auto-access item (it does not state that). Removed the unsupported 'Site 4, Vasundhara' and 'DPCC report' details. Corrected the 30,000 figure to 'will benefit' (article wording). Reworded negative 3 Hindi to match the source (dust from vehicles). Re-ranked positives: drain tender (2026) moved up to 3, Indirapuram/Vasundhara access to 4, auto access to 5 with no source. Negative 5 reworded to the notice the article reports. Added the 2026 Rajendra Nagar tender as a positive inference. Searches for 2024-2026 completed local projects and for news naming the vidhan sabha found nothing usable.
